rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_API_Resolution {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacons using dynamic API resolution via GetProcAddress and hashing"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001, T1055"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
    strings:
        $hashing_call = { E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 04 50 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 04 50 } // Common hash calc + GetProcAddress pattern
        $config_marker = { 0x69 0x6D 0x61 0x67 0x65 0x5F 0x62 0x61 0x73 0x65 } // "image_base" in config
        $useragent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" // Default CS user-agent
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        $hashing_call near 50 and
        $config_marker near 200 and
        $useragent
}

title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution from Outlook
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-enc', '-encodedcommand', '-w hidden', '-nop'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
description: Detects encoded PowerShell launched from Outlook, a common phishing payload execution method.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects configuration block in Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2d 2d 2d 2d 2d 42 45 47 49 4e 20 43 4f 4e 46 49 47 20 44 41 54 41 2d 2d 2d 2d 2d } // "-----BEGIN CONFIG DATA-----"
        $b = "uri_get" wide ascii
        $c = "uri_post" wide ascii
        $d = "host_stage" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
